name: Australia_Bushfires
description: South-eastern Australia (NSW, Victoria, southern Queensland) — recurrent eucalyptus bushfire zone, the area hit by the 2019-2020 Black Summer fires.

name: California_Wildfires
description: California, USA — a chronic wildfire region driven by drought, lightning and dry vegetation.

name: Amazon_Brazil
description: Brazilian Amazon basin — fires driven by deforestation and slash-and-burn agriculture, not armed conflict.

name: Indonesia_Peat
description: Sumatra and Kalimantan (Indonesia) — large peatland fires driven by palm-oil clearing and dry-season slash-and-burn.

name: Canada_Boreal
description: Western Canadian boreal forest (Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan) — large lightning-ignited wildfires, no armed conflict.
